title: Competitor analysis with AI: find the gaps your rivals leave
seoTitle: Competitor analysis with AI: a simple method
description: Do a competitor analysis with AI. Pick the right rivals, collect public facts from sites, ads and reviews, then build a table and find the gaps.
lede: A competitor analysis shows what your buyers could choose instead of you, and where nobody serves them well. This guide shows how to pick the right rivals and collect public evidence. Your AI then builds a comparison table with a source for every fact, and you turn the gaps into small tests.
